# @process.co/table-ai-sdk

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40process.co%2Ftable-ai-sdk)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@process.co/table-ai-sdk)
[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/process-co/npm-table-ai-sdk)](https://github.com/process-co/npm-table-ai-sdk/releases/latest)

Provider-neutral AI SDK tools for bounded, approval-gated Process Table access.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Changes in this repository are overwritten by the distribution sync from
> `process-co/proc-app`. Make source changes under `packages/table-ai-sdk` in the
> monorepo.

See the package README below for installation, server-side credential handling,
and tool registration.
